summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. Each H_k is an admissible proper halfspace through q, aggregation of the barycentric coordinates gives the stated Beta(2,29-k) cap probability F_{30-k,2}(r_k), and hence the finite depth upper bound. At b=1/50, the oblique cap has the claimed intercepts and determinant volume, all strict comparisons are certified by valid exact inequalities, and the k=27 specialization has the stated vertex incidences and exact volume. The absolute Hausdorff-volume normalization is also correct.
